        self.allSymbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        # SMA period not specified by the strategy text; 50-day is used as a
        # standard trend-following default.
        self.smaPeriod = 50
        self.spySMA = self.SMA(self.spy, self.smaPeriod, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aaplRSI = self.RSI(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilder, Resolution.Daily)

        self.SetWarmUp(max(self.smaPeriod, 14) + 5, Resolution.Daily)

        # Slot 1 - Strategy A (SPY) state
        self.lotA_shares = 0
        self.prevSpyClose = None
        self.prevSpySMA = None

        # Slot 2 - Strategy B (AAPL) state
        self.lotB_shares = 0
        self.prevAaplClose = None
        self.aaplRedStreak = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        # Continuously update market-state quantities from each symbol's own data,
        # independent of whether other subscribed tickers have data today.

        # Strategy A state: SPY close / SMA cross tracking
        spyCrossAbove = False
        spyCrossBelow = False
        if data.ContainsKey(self.spy) and data[self.spy] is not None:
            spyClose = data[self.spy].Close
            if self.spySMA.IsReady:
                spySmaVal = self.spySMA.Current.Value
                if self.prevSpyClose is not None and self.prevSpySMA is not None:
                    spyCrossAbove = (self.prevSpyClose <= self.prevSpySMA) and (spyClose > spySmaVal)
                    spyCrossBelow = (self.prevSpyClose >= self.prevSpySMA) and (spyClose < spySmaVal)
                self.prevSpyClose = spyClose
                self.prevSpySMA = spySmaVal

        # Strategy B state: AAPL red-day streak
        if data.ContainsKey(self.aapl) and data[self.aapl] is not None:
            aaplClose = data[self.aapl].Close
            if self.prevAaplClose is not None:
                if aaplClose < self.prevAaplClose:
                    self.aaplRedStreak += 1
                else:
                    self.aaplRedStreak = 0
            self.prevAaplClose = aaplClose

        # Check every subscribed ticker has a bar today; if not, skip all rule evaluation.
        for symbol in self.allSymbols:

                return

        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            return

        spyPrice = data[self.spy].Close
